top_choice_rationale: P001 gives the optical lattice clock to Katori and Ye alone: a distinct invention (magic-wavelength trapping of many neutral atoms) separate from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-ion prizes, independently reproduced and intercompared at the 1e-18 level by several national laboratories, already yielding physics (millimetre redshift, constants, dark matter), with compact credit. Adding Hosono in P002 is a mature, clean discovery but shares no thread with the clock and reads as a compromise, so I rank it second; any award above no award.
